text: All Generation 4 coverage in Albania was taken using a “smallcam” camera, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
NOTE: Most of the Balkans and southern Europe have Smallcam.
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞所有第四代 (Generation 4) 街景覆蓋都是使用「smallcam」相機拍攝的，這種相機安裝位置比一般第四代 (Generation 4) 更低，並帶有相對較大的圓形模糊 (blur) 和前方的小突出物。這種模糊 (blur) 也可能完全透明，使其更難被發現。
注意：巴爾幹半島和南歐大部分地區都有 Smallcam。

text: ‘**Rifts**’ can rarely be seen in Albanian generation 3 coverage, due to poor stitching.
NOTE: Rifts are also equally common in Montenegro, and can rarely be seen in various other countries.
text_zh: 由於拼接不良，在阿爾巴尼亞的第三代 (generation 3) 街景覆蓋中，很少能看到「**接圖裂縫**」 (rifts)。
注意：接圖裂縫 (rifts) 在蒙特內哥羅 (Montenegro) 也同樣常見，在其他許多國家則很少見。

text: You can tell the three German-speaking countries apart by **camera meta **alone:

- Austria only has **Generation 3** and Generation 4 coverage (the only exceptions being Generation 2 on [one road](https://goo.gl/maps/LebHyLrqsjkqyoZMA) in Burgenland, and several [ski resort trekkers](https://goo.gl/maps/pdquUsUJoNwZghxRA)).
- Germany only has Generation 4 coverage. (the only exceptions being spills and trekkers)
- Switzerland car coverage is always [low-cam](https://goo.gl/maps/Ey7aUdEn6vc76BZc8). This can be recognized by the much bigger car blur.
text_zh: 你光憑**相機線索特徵**就能區分這三個德語國家：
- 奧地利僅有 **第 3 代** 和第 4 代街景覆蓋（唯一的例外是布 Burgenland 的[某條道路](https://goo.gl/maps/LebHyLrqsjkqyoZMA)上有第 2 代，以及幾個[滑雪場徒步拍攝](https://goo.gl/maps/pdquUsUJoNwZghxRA)）。
- 德國只有 Generation 4 街景覆蓋。（唯一的例外是外溢畫面和徒步拍攝）
- 瑞士的汽車街景覆蓋永遠是[低鏡頭](https://goo.gl/maps/Ey7aUdEn6vc76BZc8)。這可以透過大得多的車輛模糊來識別。

text: Austria also has generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
NOTE: Most of Western Europe also has smallcam.
text_zh: 奧地利也有 Generation 4 的「小鏡頭」（smallcam）街景覆蓋，其架設高度比一般的 Generation 4 還低，並且有一個相對較大的圓形模糊，前端帶有一個小突起。這種模糊有時也會完全透明，讓人更難察覺。
註：西歐大部分地區也有小鏡頭。

text: In Generation 3 coverage, you can see two different cars:
- A white car with a [**stubby antenna**](https://goo.gl/maps/NhuDAxCVQ9TjhSUF7). There is a diagonal coil wrapped around the antenna.
- A white car with [**no antenna**](https://goo.gl/maps/nKHjWrdrmbWcUULn6).
The car’s colour is not always visible, meaning you will often see either just the stubby antenna, or no hints of the car at all.
The stubby antenna with a diagonal coil can also be found in Ecuador, Colombia, and Mexico.
text_zh: 在第 3 世代街景覆蓋中，你可以看到兩種不同的車：
- 一輛帶有[**短天線**](https://goo.gl/maps/NhuDAxCVQ9TjhSUF7)的白車。天線周圍纏繞著斜向線圈。
- 一輛[**沒有天線**](https://goo.gl/maps/nKHjWrdrmbWcUULn6)的白車。
車身顏色並不總是可見，這意味著你經常只會看到短天線，或者完全看不到車子的任何線索。
帶有斜向線圈的短天線也可以在厄瓜多、哥倫比亞和墨西哥找到。

text: The Generation 4 cars you can find in Brazil have a visible front, and have one of the following three colour patterns:
- [**Blue**](https://goo.gl/maps/cX9hiLoFAWmSxYLp8)
- [**White with a blue stripe**](https://goo.gl/maps/8m72fEE5hMYAQKF27)
- [**White**](https://goo.gl/maps/fkcFJmPtRwACz2Jv7)
text_zh: 你在巴西能找到的第 4 世代車款可以看到前方車頭，且具有以下三種顏色圖樣之一：
- [**藍色**](https://goo.gl/maps/cX9hiLoFAWmSxYLp8)
- [**帶有藍色條紋的白色**](https://goo.gl/maps/8m72fEE5hMYAQKF27)
- [**白色**](https://goo.gl/maps/fkcFJmPtRwACz2Jv7)

text: Brazil also has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front.
NOTE: Brazil, Peru and Argentina are the only South American countries with smallcam.
text_zh: 巴西也有第 4 世代「小相機（smallcam）」街景覆蓋，它的架設高度比一般第 4 世代低，且具有相對較大的圓形模糊，前方有一點小突出物。
註：巴西、秘魯和阿根廷是南美洲唯一擁有小相機（smallcam）的國家。

text: Most of the coverage in Brazil is along the **eastern **half, with only sparse coverage in the Amazon.

It is useful for beginning players to start forming a rough mental map of where the (limited) coverage is in the western half. When you get Amazonian rounds, this can prevent you from wildly plonking hundreds of kilometres away from the nearest road.
text_zh: 巴西的大多數街景覆蓋集中在**東半部**，亞馬遜地區只有稀疏的街景覆蓋。
對於新手玩家來說，開始在腦海中建立西半部（有限）街景覆蓋大略分布地圖會很有幫助。當你遇到亞馬遜地區的回合時，這可以防止你盲目下針在離最近道路幾百公里遠的地方。

text: **Area codes** are common to see in Brazil. They are often notated using parentheses, or at minimum as two separate numbers. Phone numbers are sometimes without area codes, and without them will be 8 numbers long for landline and 9 for mobile.

The pattern for each of the states is very learnable and useful. The area codes are grouped by first digit, so even just learning those can already help a lot. Notably, area codes ending in 1 will always be around major cities and state capitals.
text_zh: **電話區碼**在巴西很常見。它們通常使用括號標註，或者至少記為兩個獨立的數字。電話號碼有時不帶區碼，沒有區碼時市話為 8 位數字，手機為 9 位數字。
每個州的區碼規律非常容易學習且實用。區碼按第一個數字分組，因此光是掌握首位數字就能提供很大的幫助。值得注意的是，以 1 結尾的區碼總是位於主要城市和州首府附近。

text: **Postcodes (CEP) **are seen frequently on [street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/7RAf4dB5LnHm3PT36) in Brazil (though sometimes hard to read). The first two numbers will depict an area, a state or multiple states. The numbers go anti-clockwise from São Paulo, ending in Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 巴西的[路牌](https://goo.gl/maps/7RAf4dB5LnHm3PT36)上經常可以看到**郵遞區號（CEP）**（雖然有時很難看清）。前兩位數字代表一個區域、一個州或多個州。數字從聖保羅開始呈逆時針方向排列，最後止於南里奧格蘭德州。

text: **Phone numbers** can sometimes be seen underneath kilometre markers in São Paulo.
text_zh: 在聖保羅州，里程碑下方有時可以看到**電話號碼**。

text: In all Generation 4 coverage in Amapá, the front right of the camera is **smudged**. In addition, all Generation 4 coverage in Amapá features the white car with the blue stripe.
text_zh: 在阿馬帕州所有的 4 代街景覆蓋中，相機右前方都**有污漬**。此外，阿馬帕州所有的 4 代街景覆蓋都帶有藍色條紋的白車。

text: The 364 through Acre is very recognisable due to the **rollercoaster-like landscape and road**: the road uniquely rides the hills rather than snaking around them. There is usually no traffic, and is covered mostly by Generation 4 blue car.
text_zh: 穿過阿克里州的 364 號公路非常容易辨認，因為它有**雲霄飛車般的景觀和道路**：這條道路獨特地直接跨越丘陵，而不是繞著丘陵蜿蜒而行。通常沒有車流，且大部分是由 4 代藍車拍攝。

text: The Amazonas 319 has a very lush, bright green and tropical landscape, as it **cuts through the Amazon rainforest**. The road is flat and mostly unpaved, featuring bright orange soil. However, closer to Manaus the road becomes paved. There are wooden or ladder poles alongside the entire stretch. It is covered by the blue Generation 4 car.
text_zh: 亞馬遜州的 319 號公路擁有非常茂密、鮮綠且具熱帶風情的景觀，因為它**穿越亞馬遜雨林**。這條道路平坦且大部分未鋪設柏油，帶有鮮橘色的土壤。不過，靠近瑪瑙斯時道路會變成鋪設好的柏油路。整段路旁邊都有木桿或梯形桿。這條路是由藍色 4 代車拍攝的。

text: The Pará section of the 163 is often **hilly, curvy, dry, and sometimes hazy**. It has a wide range of amazonian vegetation. The road is frequently trafficked, usually by transportation trucks. It is covered by the blue Generation 4 car in the north and the Smallcam car in the south.
text_zh: 163 號公路帕拉州路段通常**多丘陵、多彎道、乾燥且有時霧濛濛**。它有著豐富的亞馬遜植被。這條道路車流量大，通常是運輸卡車。北方由藍色 4 代車覆蓋，南方由 Smallcam 車覆蓋。

text: You can often see **rifts** in Alagoas Generation 3 coverage.
text_zh: 你在阿拉戈斯州的 3 代街景覆蓋中經常可以看到**接圖裂縫**。

text: Northwest Rio Grande do Sul has coverage with this **camera glitch** in Generation 3.
text_zh: 南里奧格蘭德州西北部的 3 代街景覆蓋帶有這種**相機故障特徵**。

text: Canada has a fair amount of **Generation 2 coverage**, especially in rural** **or remote areas. Generation 2 can be recognized by the big circular car blur and the halo-like colour distortion in the sky.
NOTE: Generation 2 is very rare in the US. If you are between Canada and the US, and the location is in Generation 2, you are much more likely to be in Canada.
text_zh: 加拿大有相當數量的**第 2 世代街景覆蓋**，特別是在鄉村** **或偏遠地區。第 2 世代的特徵是車底有大型圓形模糊，以及天空呈現光暈狀的色彩失真。
註：第 2 世代在美國非常罕見。如果你在加拿大與美國之間猶豫，而該地點屬於第 2 世代，那麼很有可能是在加拿大。

text: **Generation 3** is significantly more common in Canada than in the US.
In addition, the side mirrors are blurred out differently: While they generally appear as **two peaks** in Canadian Gen 3 coverage, you will mostly see a single peak in the US.
text_zh: **第 3 世代**在加拿大比在美國普遍得多。
此外，後視鏡的模糊方式也有所不同：加拿大 Gen 3 街景覆蓋中的後視鏡模糊通常會呈現**兩個凸起**，而美國則多半只會看到單個凸起。

text: Both the US and Canada also have Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot. When the car isn’t blurred properly, you will usually see a mirror sticking out on the right side.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大也都有第 4 世代「smallcam」街景覆蓋，其架設高度比一般的第 4 世代低，並且下方有一個相對較大的圓形模糊，前端帶有小凸起。該模糊也可能完全透明，使其更難察覺。當車子沒有被完美模糊時，你通常會看到右側凸出一個後視鏡。

text: Rural roads in Alberta are numbered sequentially. This makes it easy to figure out your exact location using just a road sign.
- **Township roads** (Twp Rd) run east to west. Their numbers increase the more north you go.
- **Range roads** (Rge Rd) run north to south. Their numbers increase the more west you go. These numbers reset a couple of times.

[This infographic](/images/canada/canada_albertatownshipgrid.png) shows which numbers are found where. You need to multiply the numbers on the grid by 10 to get the road numbers. For example, the junction in the image example is found just north of Red Deer.
NOTE: Similarly named roads can also sometimes be seen in Saskatchewan, however they are more common in Alberta.
text_zh: 亞伯達省的鄉村道路按順序編號。這讓你僅憑道路標誌就能輕鬆確定具體位置。
- **鄉鎮道路**（Twp Rd）呈東西走向。越往北走，編號越大。
- **範圍道路**（Rge Rd）呈南北走向。越往西走，編號越大。這些編號會重置數次。
[這張圖表](/images/canada/canada_albertatownshipgrid.png)顯示了各編號的分佈位置。你需要將網格上的數字乘以 10 才能得到道路編號。例如，圖例中的交叉路口位於紅鹿市正北方。
註：類似命名的道路偶爾也會出現在薩克其萬省，不過在亞伯達省更常見。

text: Rural roads in Manitoba are organised in a grid and referred to only by their number and cardinal direction.
- Roads ending in **N** run east to west. Their numbers increase by one for every mile north of the US border.
- Roads with **E** or **W** run north to south. They tell you their position relative to the principal meridian, located just west of Winnipeg.
For instance, this image was taken 105 miles north of the US border and 147 miles west of the principal meridian.
text_zh: 曼尼托巴省的鄉村道路呈網格狀規劃，僅以數字和方位來命名。
- 以 **N** 結尾的道路呈東西走向。美加邊界以北每增加一英里，數字就增加一。
- 帶有 **E** 或 **W** 的道路呈南北走向。它們標示出相對於首要子午線（位於溫尼伯正西側）的位置。
例如，這張照片拍於美加邊界以北 105 英里、首要子午線以西 147 英里之處。

text: Canadian phone numbers start with a **three-digit area code**. Both landlines and mobile phones use the same area codes.
NOTE: Canadian phone numbers are formatted XXX XXX XXXX, with the area code being the first three digits. It is fairly common to see 7-digit numbers with the area code omitted.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 加拿大的電話號碼以**三位數的區號**開頭。市話和手機都使用相同的區號。
註：加拿大電話號碼格式為 XXX XXX XXXX，前三位數為區號。省略區號的 7 位數號碼相當常見。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Costa Rica’s Generation 4 imagery was captured using a large **white pickup truck**. In many locations, it is either fully or partially visible, but can occasionally be entirely blurred out. There is an antenna attached to the front of the car.

NOTE: The Panamanian truck is almost always [fully blurred out](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SXjYfDTrfFwZTWLs8). The truck used in [Ecuador](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dSweUPGTkgTasq9B7) does not have an antenna.
text_zh: 哥斯大黎加的第 4 代街景影像是由一台大型的**白色皮卡車**所拍攝的。在許多地方，它會完全或部分可見，但偶爾也可能完全被模糊處理。車子前方裝有一根天線。
注意：巴拿馬的卡車幾乎總是[完全被模糊處理](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SXjYfDTrfFwZTWLs8)。[厄瓜多](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dSweUPGTkgTasq9B7)使用的卡車沒有天線。

text: Grote Berg, located in the centre of the island, can be recognised by the **stick** stuck to the front of the camera lens.
text_zh: Grote Berg 位於島嶼中心，可以透過黏在相機鏡頭前方的**棍子**來辨識。

text: France has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
NOTE: Most of Western Europe also has smallcam.
text_zh: 法國擁有 Generation 4「小相機」街景覆蓋，其安裝位置比一般的 Generation 4 更低，並有一個相對大的圓形模糊，前方有一個小突起。模糊效果也可能完全透明，讓人更難以察覺。
註：西歐大部分地區也有小鏡頭。

text: This guide will mainly operate with two types of administrative divisions: [**regions**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regions_of_France), totalling at **13** in European France, and **96 **[**departments**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Departments_of_France), which appear on google maps as the primary administrative divisions. Other rarer divisions you may come across include [pre 2016 regions](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/df/Map_Carte_des_Anciennes_R%C3%A9gions_2015.png/1024px-Map_Carte_des_Anciennes_R%C3%A9gions_2015.png), [historical provinces](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d9/France_in_1789.svg/1024px-France_in_1789.svg.png), and [regions based on cardinal directions](https://www.ffft.fr/sites/default/files/images/d%C3%A9coupage%20r%C3%A9gions%20FFFT%20et%20officielles.jpg).
Departments are often named after physical geographical features and their logos may show up on various infrastructure, shown in the next tip.
_You can practise them with [this quiz](https://geo.emily.bz/map-quiz/france/departments)._
text_zh: 本指南主要使用兩種類型的行政區劃：[**大區**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regions_of_France)（歐洲法國境內總計 **13** 個），以及在 Google 地圖上顯示為主要行政區劃的 **96** 個[**省份**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Departments_of_France)。你可能會遇到的其他較罕見區劃包括[2016年以前的大區](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/df/Map_Carte_des_Anciennes_R%C3%A9gions_2015.png/1024px-Map_Carte_des_Anciennes_R%C3%A9gions_2015.png)、[歷史行省](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d9/France_in_1789.svg/1024px-France_in_1789.svg.png)，以及[基於方位方向的大區](https://www.ffft.fr/sites/default/files/images/d%C3%A9coupage%20r%C3%A9gions%20FFFT%20et%20officielles.jpg)。
省份通常以自然地理特徵命名，其標誌可能會出現在各種基礎設施上，如接下來的提示所示。
_你可以透過[這個測驗](https://geo.emily.bz/map-quiz/france/departments)來練習它們。_

text: French telephone numbers are 10 digits long, with the first two pairs of digits being two separate area codes, following two patterns:
- 01 is in Île-de-France and 02-05 goes **clockwise **from the northwest.
- 2X is in the far north, with the numbers generally increasing **anticlockwise**. 9X is an exception, being found both in the far northwest and far southeast.
Secondary area codes in Île-de-France can be seen on [this map](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0d/Indicatif_telephonique_IDF.jpg/1280px-Indicatif_telephonique_IDF.jpg).
NOTE: Phone numbers beginning with 06-09 are not regional.
text_zh: 法國電話號碼為 10 位數，前兩組數字為兩個獨立的區號，遵循兩種模式：
- 01 位於法蘭西島，02-05 從西北方開始**順時針**排列。
- 2X 位於極北地區，數字通常**逆時針**遞增。9X 是一個例外，在極西北和極東南都能找到。
法蘭西島的次要區號可以在[這張地圖](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0d/Indicatif_telephonique_IDF.jpg/1280px-Indicatif_telephonique_IDF.jpg)上看到。
NOTE: 06-09 開頭的電話號碼不分區域。

text: Each department has an assigned number to it, arranged mostly [alphabetically](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Departments_of_France#Current_departments). This is most useful in postal codes, consisting of 5 digits, the first two representing the department they’re in.
NOTE: the same regional codes are used inside the right blue strip on [licence plates](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hdSg7fcVKbUGPcjP8).
text_zh: 每個省份都有一個指定的編號，大多按[字母順序](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Departments_of_France#Current_departments)排列。這在郵遞區號中最有用，郵遞區號由 5 位數組成，前兩位數代表他們所在的省份。
注意：相同的區域代碼也用於[車牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hdSg7fcVKbUGPcjP8)右側的藍色條帶內。

text: Most departments have their own unique logo (formally called official flag), often containing stylized initials or the entire name. Notable infrastructure with department logos include [bus stops](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1CqFWtzhUqLV2k8n7), [kilometre markers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JGY1Xwa8SvPyyV5A9), [trail banners](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kP4kjMrH3rK5gLSZ7), [directional signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QM5gqNqrRtf4gWRR6) and [signbacks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZHA8UMQL6eFzSNyP6). Learning what each logo looks like is not recommended for beginners, but it can be helpful to know what they stand for when scanning.

You can find the full list of logos [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#French_Departments), or see them projected onto a map [here](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Flag_Map_of_Departments_of_France_Version_2_%28Logo_Flags%29.png).
text_zh: 大多數省份都有自己獨特的標誌（正式稱為官方旗幟），通常包含風格化的縮寫或全名。帶有省份標誌的知名基礎設施包括[公車站](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1CqFWtzhUqLV2k8n7)、[公里標石](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JGY1Xwa8SvPyyV5A9)、[步道標示](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kP4kjMrH3rK5gLSZ7)、[方向標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QM5gqNqrRtf4gWRR6)和[標誌背面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZHA8UMQL6eFzSNyP6)。不建議初學者學習每個標誌長什麼樣子，但在掃描時了解它們代表什麼會很有幫助。

你可以在[這裡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#French_Departments)找到標誌的完整列表，或在[這裡](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Flag_Map_of_Departments_of_France_Version_2_%28Logo_Flags%29.png)查看它們在地圖上的投影。

text: On rare occasions, you may find a flag attached to the antenna in the generation 3 coverage. While much of the highlighted areas has been overwritten, learning the distribution of each antenna can yield very high scores.
NOTE: All pictured colourful antenna flags are unique to France.
text_zh: 在罕見的情況下，你可能會在相機世代 3（generation 3）覆蓋的天線上發現一面旗幟。雖然許多標示區域已被覆蓋更新，但了解每個天線的分佈可以獲得非常高的分數。
注意：所有照片中色彩繽紛的天線旗幟都是法國獨有的。

text: Generation 4 coverage in Ghana was taken using a **grey** or white **pickup truck** with an antenna in the front. The truck will be either fully or partially **blurred **most of the time.
text_zh: 迦納的第四代街景覆蓋是使用一台前方裝有天線的**灰色**或白色**皮卡車**（pickup truck）拍攝的。這台卡車在大多數時間裡會被完全或部分**打上馬賽克**。

text: The coverage in Ghana is **limited **and easy to memorize, as most of it was taken on its main roads and in major cities. The most dense coverage is located in the south, around the cities of Accra and Kumasi.
text_zh: 迦納的街景覆蓋**有限**且容易記住，因為大部分的街景都是在其主要幹道和大城市中拍攝的。最密集的街景覆蓋位於南部，也就是阿克拉（Accra）和庫馬西（Kumasi）等城市周邊。

text: The majority of generation 4 coverage is close to Accra or Kumasi, with only a few major roads being covered.
text_zh: 大多數第四代街景覆蓋都在阿克拉或庫馬西附近，只有少數主要道路有街景覆蓋。

text: Coverage in Indonesia is fairly limited. Notably, there is no coverage on Papua or adjacent islands, and coverage is sparse in areas such as Kalimantan, Aceh, Central Sulawesi and North Maluku.
text_zh: 印尼的街景覆蓋相當有限。值得注意的是，巴布亞或鄰近島嶼沒有街景覆蓋，且在加里曼丹、亞齊、中蘇拉威西和北馬魯古等地區的覆蓋相當稀疏。

text: The names of 2nd level subdivisions, named **‘Kabupaten’ **or **‘Kab’ **for short, translating to regency, can be found all over Indonesia on various signs and billboards. Each province is split up into multiple Kabupatens, totalling to 417 which are covered by street view, and therefore applicable in Geoguessr. These are learnable with enough time and patience.
_See the resources section for more information._
text_zh: 第二級行政區的名稱（簡稱為**「Kabupaten」**或**「Kab」**，意為縣）可以在印尼各地的各種標誌和告示牌上找到。每個省份都被劃分為多個縣，街景涵蓋範圍總計有 417 個，因此可用於 GeoGuessr 中。只要給予足夠的時間和耐心，這些都是可以學會的。
_請參閱資源章節以獲取更多資訊。_

text: While kabupaten names appear significantly more often, a number of [signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UgV2DtQbn4qVDL9t5) also display the **postal code**. Postal codes are five digits long and grouped by their starting digit, ranging from 1xxxx in Jakarta to 9xxxx in Maluku and Papua.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 雖然縣名出現的頻率顯著高得多，但許多[招牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UgV2DtQbn4qVDL9t5)也顯示了**郵遞區號**。郵遞區號為五位數，按其起始數字分組，從雅加達的 1xxxx 到馬魯古和巴布亞的 9xxxx。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Generation 3 antenna** coverage is most commonly found on Java, but can very rarely be seen on Bali in and around Denpasar. It is most commonly seen in East Java, as most of the antenna coverage in the west has been overwritten by Generation 4.
text_zh: **第三代相機天線**覆蓋最常出現在爪哇，但極少數情況下可以在峇里島的登巴薩市內及周邊看到。它最常見於東爪哇，因為西部的多數天線覆蓋已被第四代覆蓋。

text: Black Generation 3 coverage can be found almost everywhere in Indonesia, but is most common in **Sulawesi**.
text_zh: 黑色第三代相機覆蓋幾乎可以在印尼各地找到，但在**蘇拉威西**最為常見。

text: This camera glitch, reminiscent of a **Moiré Pattern**, is found throughout Central Kalimantan.
_You can click on the image for a clearer view._
text_zh: 這種讓人聯想到**莫爾紋**的相機故障，在整個中加里曼丹都能找到。
_你可以點擊圖片以檢視更清晰的畫面。_

text: A **white **SUV with black bars and a wooden plank on the roof can rarely be seen in eastern Bali.
text_zh: 在峇里島東部，很少見到一台帶有黑色橫桿且車頂放有木板的**白色**休旅車（SUV）。

text: A **black cab** with men sitting in the truck bed can be seen near Jagasatru on Bali.
text_zh: 在峇里島賈加薩特魯（Jagasatru）附近，可以看到一台載著男人的貨斗的**計程車**（black cab）。

text: Italy has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
text_zh: 義大利有第 4 代「小型相機（smallcam）」街景覆蓋，其安裝位置比一般第 4 代低，並且有一個相對大的圓形模糊，前端有一個小突起。模糊也可以完全透明，使得它更難被發現。

text: Italian **area codes** follow a pattern where the first digit generally increases to the east, then south.
text_zh: 義大利的**區域號碼**遵循一個規律，即第一位數字通常向東、然後向南遞增。

text: Each Italian region has its own unique flag.
text_zh: 每個義大利大區都有自己獨特的旗幟。

text: The Campione d'Italia **exclave** in Switzerland can be recognized by its low camera, having a long antenna and a flag. There is also a body of water to the west.

NOTE: This antenna can also be found in several areas in [Switzerland](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.8917308,9.0384397,3a,38.3y,19.25h,71.73t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0x8K6Xn3tuFsalTznE_BGw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656).
text_zh: 位於瑞士的坎皮奧內d'義大利（Campione d'Italia）**飛地**可以藉由其低相機、長天線和一面旗幟來識別。西部還有一個水域。
注意：這個天線也可以在[瑞士](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.8917308,9.0384397,3a,38.3y,19.25h,71.73t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0x8K6Xn3tuFsalTznE_BGw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)的幾個地區找到。

text: The island of San Domino only has **overcast Generation 2** coverage, which mostly looks quite gloomy.
text_zh: 聖多米諾島（San Domino）只有**陰天第 2 代**街景覆蓋，看起來大都相當陰暗。

text: Kenya is mostly covered in Generation 4 **pickup truck coverage**. Most trucks are blurred out, but sometimes you can see parts of the car, which can be many different colors, or a **snorkel**.
NOTE: It is the only country other than Mongolia with a snorkel in Generation 4.
text_zh: 肯亞大部分地區都有第 4 代**皮卡車街景覆蓋**。大多數車輛都被模糊處理，但有時你可以看到車子的部分車身（可能有各種不同的顏色）或**吸氣管**。
注意：它是除了蒙古之外，唯一在第 4 代有吸氣管的國家。

text: On a lot of the coverage you will see a grey Toyota SUV following the Street View car.
text_zh: 在許多街景中，你會看到一台灰色的 Toyota 休旅車跟在 Google 車後面。

text: Generation 3 coverage in Kenya often features a **visible roof rack ** and a **snorkel**. Some Generation 3 coverage has [no visible car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UGBAo7hH2mhLsUv46).
text_zh: 肯亞的 Generation 3 街景通常帶有**明顯的車頂架**和**進氣 snorkel**。部分 Generation 3 街景則[看不到車子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UGBAo7hH2mhLsUv46)。

text: Upon closer inspection of signs, billboards and posters, you will notice that the **county name** is often written. Therefore, knowledge of Kenyan counties can be extremely useful in region guessing.
_You can practise Kenyan counties using the quiz in the resource section._
text_zh: 仔細檢查路標、大型看板和海報時，你會發現通常會寫上**郡名**。因此，熟悉肯亞的郡對於猜測區域非常有用。
_你可以使用資源區中的測驗來練習肯亞的郡。_

text: Most of the coverage in Kenya outside of the southwest is limited to **main roads**.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 肯亞除了西南部之外，大部分的街景覆蓋都侷限在**主要道路**上。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Post codes in Kenya can be identified by [signs in the format PO BOX XXX-YYYZZ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zkoZ8sYzmTGiRivA6), where the number YYY (usually 3 digits but sometimes 0) corresponds to a post code. This is the number which can be used to narrow down your guess. Often, the name of the city is listed after the PO BOX.
NOTE: You can sometimes see [PO BOX without the second number](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sNta3QHeJpwVVgoDA) after the hyphen which is not helpful.

_You can click on the image to enlarge it. Here is a _[quiz](https://www.super-duper.fr/quiz2024/areacodes.php?country=POST_KE&language=en&tile=gmaps&border=thin&difficulty=false&timer=false&gmaplng=en)_ to help practice Kenyan post codes_
text_zh: 肯亞的郵遞區號可透過[格式為 PO BOX XXX-YYYZZ 的標示](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zkoZ8sYzmTGiRivA6)來辨識，其中數字 YYY（通常為 3 位數，但有時為 0）對應到郵遞區號。這個數字可用來縮小你的猜測範圍。通常 PO BOX 後面會列出城市名稱。
注意：有時候你會看到連字號後面[沒有第二個數字的 PO BOX](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sNta3QHeJpwVVgoDA)，這對判斷沒有幫助。
_你可以點擊圖片將其放大。這裡有一個_[測驗](https://www.super-duper.fr/quiz2024/areacodes.php?country=POST_KE&language=en&tile=gmaps&border=thin&difficulty=false&timer=false&gmaplng=en)_可協助練習肯亞郵遞區號_

text: All Generation 4 coverage in Montenegro was taken using a “smallcam” camera, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
NOTE: Most of the Balkans and southern Europe have Smallcam.
text_zh: 蒙特內哥羅的所有第四代街景覆蓋都是使用「smallcam」相機拍攝的，該相機比一般的第四代安裝位置更低，並且具有相對大的圓形模糊，前端帶有一個小突起。模糊效果也可能是完全透明的，這使得它更難被發現。
注意：巴爾幹半島和南歐大部分地區都有 Smallcam。

text: ‘**Rifts**’ can uncommonly be seen in Montenegrin generation 3 coverage, due to poor stitching.
NOTE: Rifts are also common in Albania, and can rarely be seen in various other countries.
text_zh: 由於接圖品質不佳，在蒙特內哥羅的第 3 代街景中偶爾可以看到 **接圖裂縫**。
注意：接圖裂縫在阿爾巴尼亞也很常見，在其他少數國家則極少見。

text: Although rifts are common in generation 3 Montenegro coverage, coastal rounds **will almost never **have them. By the coast, there will be a [short antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/d7Fvp2NzZw37CxyFA) with no rifts. There will be a [long antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/Zpu6fUJ5o3LkTtxZ6) with rifts inland.
NOTE: An exception to this is the area around the coastal villages of Utjeha and Dobra Voda.
text_zh: 雖然接圖裂縫在第 3 代蒙特內哥羅街景中很常見，但沿海地區的拍攝 **幾乎絕對不會** 出現裂縫。在沿海地區，會有一個沒有裂縫的 [短天線](https://goo.gl/maps/d7Fvp2NzZw37CxyFA)。而在內陸，則會有一個帶有裂縫的 [長天線](https://goo.gl/maps/Zpu6fUJ5o3LkTtxZ6)。
注意：烏特列哈（Utjeha）和多布拉沃達（Dobra Voda）等沿海村莊周遭地區是個例外。

text: Within mainland Africa, Nigeria is currently the only country to have this **low-quality coverage**, known as official ari**, **or “shitcam”.

NOTE: Low quality coverage taken between 2023 and 2025 has especially [low quality](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FRmNSTEtGszBkRqEA). Often you can see huge cars through the blur, and this extremely low quality only appears elsewhere in Lebanon.
text_zh: 在非洲大陸內，奈及利亞目前是唯一擁有這種**低畫質街景覆蓋**的國家，被稱為官方 shitcam，或俗稱「大便相機」。
備註：2023年至2025年間拍攝的低畫質街景具有特別[低畫質](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FRmNSTEtGszBkRqEA)。通常你可以透過模糊看到巨大的車輛，而這種極低的畫質只會在黎巴嫩的其他地方出現。

text: All Generation 4 coverage in North Macedonia was taken using a “smallcam” camera, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
NOTE: Most of the Balkans and southern Europe have Smallcam.
text_zh: 北馬其頓的所有相機世代 4 街景覆蓋都是使用「小相機（smallcam）」拍攝的，該相機安裝得比一般相機世代 4 更低，並具有一個相對大的圓形模糊，前端帶有一個小突起。模糊也可以是完全透明的，這使得它更難被發現。
注意：巴爾幹半島和南歐大部分地區都有 Smallcam。

text: There will **never be an antenna **on the Google car.
Every other country in Europe will have an antenna sometimes in Generation 3 coverage. For clarity’s sake: this means that cars with no antenna can be found outside North Macedonia.
NOTE: The only other country to have no antenna the majority of the time is Serbia, although there will be an antenna sometimes.
text_zh: Google 車上**絕不會有天線**。
歐洲的其他每個國家在相機世代 3 的街景覆蓋中偶爾都會有天線。為了釐清起見：這意味著沒有天線的車輛可以在北馬其頓境外找到。
備註：大多數時候沒有天線的唯一其他國家是塞爾維亞，儘管偶爾還是會有天線。

text: Generation 3 Coverage is **sparse**, only including some highways and some cities in the country.
The cities of Skopje, Bitola, Kumanovo, Prilep, Tetovo, Veles, Ohrid, and Strumica are the only ones with significant coverage inside the city.
You can view the official coverage in more detail on [this site](https://sv-map.netlify.app#base=roadmap&cov=official&zoom=9&center=41.4828622445409%2C22.178649902343754).
text_zh: 相機世代 3 的街景覆蓋**稀少**，僅包含該國的一些高速公路和一些城市。
斯科普里（Skopje）、比托拉（Bitola）、庫馬諾沃（Kumanovo）、普里萊普（Prilep）、泰托沃（Tetovo）、韋利士（Veles）、奧赫里德（Ohrid）和斯特魯米察（Strumica）是城內擁有顯著街景覆蓋僅有的幾個城市。
你可以在[這個網站](https://sv-map.netlify.app#base=roadmap&cov=official&zoom=9&center=41.4828622445409%2C22.178649902343754)上查看更詳細的官方街景覆蓋。

text: In GENERATION 3 coverage A** green truck** is visible behind the Google Car for a portion of the E-65. The truck is visible from Kichevo to Arbinovo.
NOTE: This hint is mostly obsolete
text_zh: 在相機世代 3 的街景覆蓋中，E-65 的其中一段路程中，Google 車後方可以看到一台**綠色卡車**。從基切沃（Kichevo）到阿爾比諾沃（Arbinovo）都可以看到這台卡車。
備註：這個提示大多已經過時

text: Panama was covered by a large white pickup truck that is usually **entirely blurred**. An antenna is occasionally visible.

NOTE: The [Costa Rican](https://maps.app.goo.gl/468aLVF3daz21MRLA) truck is usually unblurred. The car used in [Ecuador](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dSweUPGTkgTasq9B7) has neither an antenna nor a white metal railing.
text_zh: 巴拿馬由一台大型白色皮卡車進行街景拍攝，通常**完全被模糊處理**。偶爾可以看到天線。
註：[哥斯大黎加](https://maps.app.goo.gl/468aLVF3daz21MRLA)的車通常沒有模糊處理。[厄瓜多](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dSweUPGTkgTasq9B7)使用的車輛既沒有天線也沒有白色金屬欄杆。

text: While Panama is quite well covered, there is barely any coverage on the north coast, or east of Panama City.
text_zh: 雖然巴拿馬的街景覆蓋率相當完整，但在北海岸或巴拿馬市以東幾乎沒有街景。

text: The first digit of phone numbers can be used to regionguess Panama.
The numbers with a smaller font indicate potentially useful [regional two-digit codes](https://goo.gl/maps/fgoa9tJUxY5QL2C56).
NOTE: Only phone numbers with 7 digits are helpful, and any numbers starting with 5, 6, or 8 are useless as well.
text_zh: 電話號碼的第一位數字可以用來判斷巴拿馬的區域。
字型較小的數字代表可能有用的[區域兩位數區碼](https://goo.gl/maps/fgoa9tJUxY5QL2C56)。
注意：只有 7 位數的電話號碼才有幫助，任何以 5、6 或 8 開頭的號碼也沒有用。

text: The first digit of taxi and bus licence plates can be used to regionguess Panama.
NOTE: Cars travel, so they are not always reliable, especially outside of cities.
text_zh: 計程車與公車車牌的第一位數字可以用來判斷巴拿馬的區域。
注意：車輛會移動，所以不一定完全可靠，特別是在城市外面。

text: **Sunset **coverage can be found in southern Panama on a small road south of Tonosi.
text_zh: 在巴拿馬南部的東諾西（Tonosi）南方的一條小路上，可以找到**日落**街景覆蓋。

text: Three Generation 3 Street View cars are commonly found in Russia. The two most useful ones for recognising Russia are a black and a [white](https://goo.gl/maps/MmC3SpuSmhV5ezux9) car, both with a long antenna. You may also see a [short antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/x1ryuJiJL9VjkEWx6) without a visible car.
NOTE: Short antenna without a visible car in Generation 3 is common in Europe. Both black and white cars with long antenna can show up in Generation 3 Europe, but are not as common.
text_zh: 俄羅斯常見三種第三代 Google 車。用來識別俄羅斯最有用的兩輛車是一輛黑色和一輛[白色](https://goo.gl/maps/MmC3SpuSmhV5ezux9)車，兩者都有長天線。你可能也會看到沒有可見車輛的[短天線](https://goo.gl/maps/x1ryuJiJL9VjkEWx6)。
注意：第三代中沒有可見車輛的短天線在歐洲很常見。帶有長天線的黑車和白車都可能出現在第三代歐洲街景中，但沒有那麼常見。

text: The eastern half of the Kolyma Highway going to Magadan features a lot of tall **hills** and **mountains**, usually shrouded in a **haze**. Most of the roads are unpaved and feature **dark gravelly soil**. The haze is not present in the western half.
text_zh: 科雷馬公路通往馬加丹的東半段有許多高大的**山丘**和**山脈**，通常籠罩在**薄霧**中。大部分道路都未鋪路，且具有**深色碎石土壤**。西半段則沒有薄霧。

text: Very **hazy coverage** is found east and south of Mirny, especially along the Vilyuy river. The colour of the haze varies, but it is often orange or [white](https://goo.gl/maps/QMfuHapbJnFYAyop6).
text_zh: 米爾內（Mirny）以東與以南可以找到非常**霧濛濛的街景覆蓋**（hazy coverage），特別是在維柳伊河（Vilyuy river）沿岸。霧氣的顏色會變，但通常是橘色或[白色](https://goo.gl/maps/QMfuHapbJnFYAyop6)。

text: This **forest fire haze** is found near Lake Gusinoye, southwest of Ulan-Ude in Buryatia. While similar to the haze found near [Mirny](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kZY7oWKZW3bHoFp5A), the Buryatia haze coverage can typically be recognised by the **open rolling landscape**, which is not found near Mirny.
text_zh: 這種**森林大火煙霧**（forest fire haze）可以在布里雅特烏蘭烏德（Ulan-Ude）西南方的古西諾耶湖（Lake Gusinoye）附近找到。雖然它類似於[米爾內](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kZY7oWKZW3bHoFp5A)附近的霧氣，但布里雅特的霧霾街景通常可以透過**開闊的起伏地景**來辨認，這是米爾內附近所沒有的。

text: The main road of Altai Republic has a black car long antenna driving north **through the Altai Mountains**, often with **foggy or rainy** coverage.
text_zh: 阿爾泰共和國（Altai Republic）的主幹道有一輛長天線黑車，正**穿過阿爾泰山脈**向北行駛，通常伴隨著**起霧或下雨**的街景覆蓋。

text: This is a map of Russian **area codes**. Notably, area codes starting with 8 are in the west, codes starting with 3 are fairly central and codes starting with 4 are either east or around Moscow.
text_zh: 這是一張俄羅斯**區碼**的地圖。值得注意的是，以 8 開頭的區碼位於西部，以 3 開頭的相當靠中央，而以 4 開頭的則位於東部或莫斯科周邊。

text: This is the full coverage map of Russia. It can be helpful to know areas where there isn’t any coverage. The coverage is notably very sparse in the east and north.
You can check out the extent of the official coverage[ on this website](https://sv-map.netlify.app/#base=roadmap&cov=official&zoom=4&center=63.09475846224108%2C101.77734375000001).
text_zh: 這是俄羅斯的完整街景覆蓋地圖。了解沒有街景覆蓋的區域會很有幫助。東部和北部的覆蓋率特別稀疏。
你可以在[這個網站](https://sv-map.netlify.app/#base=roadmap&cov=official&zoom=4&center=63.09475846224108%2C101.77734375000001)上查看官方街景覆蓋的範圍。

text: [White car long antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/szUNXBWMYPjJ6jMA6) is found in many places, most commonly in [southern Chelyabinsk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/u2ofsEtYhTK1kxpr9), on [snow coverage around Novosibirsk](https://goo.gl/maps/WT1mwvr1mZH9Nsy88), and in the [Far East](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UcNfar31Lf4yD8pD7) beginning in [Amur Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uJivjvnTnNdf4LHq5).

NOTE: While [Kamchatka](https://goo.gl/maps/vbKvMrHXtE7anj636) technically has a silver car (with a B type antenna), it often appears white and is part of the small group of exceptions to black and white.
text_zh: [白色長天線車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/szUNXBWMYPjJ6jMA6)在許多地方都可以見到，最常見於[車里雅賓斯克南部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/u2ofsEtYhTK1kxpr9)、[新西伯利亞周邊的雪地覆蓋路段](https://goo.gl/maps/WT1mwvr1mZH9Nsy88)，以及從[阿穆爾州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UcNfar31Lf4yD8pD7)開始的[遠東地區](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uJivjvnTnNdf4LHq5)。
注意：雖然[堪察加](https://goo.gl/maps/vbKvMrHXtE7anj636)嚴格來說有一輛銀色車（配備 B 型天線），但它通常看起來是白色的，且屬於黑白車輛特徵的少數例外之一。

text: The [A-type short antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/13hZAJw2TiAoyFP17) has its highest ridge on the right. Notable areas for this antenna are around [Kaluga](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JvchV2vn13QwiTG57), [Orenburg](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nYa3htnmJtm9RUEc9), and [Krasnodar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/48JHYVMTGEwN7XCu8).
text_zh: [A 型短天線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/13hZAJw2TiAoyFP17)最高的一道脊在右側。這種天線常見的區域有[卡盧加](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JvchV2vn13QwiTG57)、[奧倫堡](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nYa3htnmJtm9RUEc9)和[克拉斯諾達爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/48JHYVMTGEwN7XCu8)周邊。

text: The [B-type short antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/otoKbscwAem4eCh89) has its highest ridge on the left. This antenna is wide-ranging, but it is most notably found near [Nizhny Novgorod](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6nmWkEgaUkHRydZt5), [Elista](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sb6XLo7VMBzFQiiu8), and [Yekaterinburg](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3VHAgPgQ6EWcbjys8) and [Tyumen](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rcYGf1PeEnWmD1Sc6).
text_zh: [B 型短天線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/otoKbscwAem4eCh89)最高的一道脊在左側。這種天線分佈廣泛，但最常出現在[下諾夫哥羅德](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6nmWkEgaUkHRydZt5)、[埃利斯塔](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sb6XLo7VMBzFQiiu8)、[葉卡捷琳堡](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3VHAgPgQ6EWcbjys8)及[秋明](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rcYGf1PeEnWmD1Sc6)附近。

text: The [B-type pronounced antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WwzMFjRSbmQUgBHB9) is the same as the B-type antenna but the ridge is more “rectangular”. This antenna is fairly limited, only being found commonly in [Moscow Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tziG6gD8RNd8ByJN8), [Kurgan Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HMFY2AUsYsPMmEFm6), [near Krasnoyarsk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Wv94BFV16DXcfnVx6), and [southwest Krasnodar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9hM7GWG3Mk7AazpJ7).
text_zh: [B 型明顯天線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WwzMFjRSbmQUgBHB9)與 B 型天線相同，但脊的形狀更偏向「長方形」。這種天線相當少見，主要常見於[莫斯科州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tziG6gD8RNd8ByJN8)、[庫爾干州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HMFY2AUsYsPMmEFm6)、[克拉斯諾亞爾斯克附近](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Wv94BFV16DXcfnVx6)以及[克拉斯諾達爾西南部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9hM7GWG3Mk7AazpJ7)。

text: The [C-type short antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7WisPoWqAk3itE7eA) can be thought of as a low A-type or a “twisting antenna” with the ridges being further from the top. It is found [north](https://maps.app.goo.gl/snkxCqnaS1bZc1hY9) and [east](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6gMAwy8bad7C9J2dA) of Moscow, with the furthest south being [Rostov Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GjFfAVgNQaRzLKkL7).
text_zh: [C 型短天線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7WisPoWqAk3itE7eA)可以看作是較低的 A 型或是「扭曲天線」，其脊的位置距離頂部更遠。它分佈在莫斯科[北面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/snkxCqnaS1bZc1hY9)與[東面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6gMAwy8bad7C9J2dA)，最南端可達[羅斯托夫州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GjFfAVgNQaRzLKkL7)。

text: The [blurred short antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8uWV4EHvPCH1dZKUA) is visibly blurrier than any of the other short antennas. It is mainly found in two major clusters around [Ufa](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rgZgng4EcRjznQuP6) and from [Stavropol](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7d5Q8kbPNPQPDMuGA) to [Makhachkala](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ujH4F6CZZc3qeSRN7).
text_zh: [模糊短天線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8uWV4EHvPCH1dZKUA)明顯比其他短天線還要模糊。它主要分佈在兩個主要區域：[烏法](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rgZgng4EcRjznQuP6)周邊，以及從[斯塔夫羅波爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7d5Q8kbPNPQPDMuGA)到[馬哈奇卡拉](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ujH4F6CZZc3qeSRN7)的帶狀區域。

text: The [A-type long antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PuGiesP9DAUdSiRKA) has its highest ridge on the right side. Notable areas include [Leningrad Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4GDjJxHqF2cerU1RA), [Republic of Karelia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MN3ZHGme7BvopS7h9), and [Vologda Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KRnogy4K1mUbL9y99). Almost all the white car long antenna coverage is A-type, so checking for A-type can also help confirm car colour.
text_zh: [A 型長天線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PuGiesP9DAUdSiRKA)最高的一道脊在右側。顯著的區域包含[列寧格勒州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4GDjJxHqF2cerU1RA)、[卡累利阿共和國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MN3ZHGme7BvopS7h9)以及[沃洛格達州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KRnogy4K1mUbL9y99)。幾乎所有白色長天線車的街景都是 A 型，因此檢查是否為 A 型也有助於確認車輛顏色。

text: The [B-type long antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xiJHmjsXcMQyQZ1d9) has its highest ridge on the left side. Notable areas include [Yaroslav](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZdC9XJiP3NKKA9QA6) to [Vladimir](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wEscjWspwirDVd696), [Tula Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ajNom88LdYrKfRAX6), and much of the coverage near [Tuva](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icUb6qp4Y8MzFd2P7) and [Irkutsk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UmZN7hTvhWZv6yKk8).

NOTE: There are two other long antenna types, referred to as [CA](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eMwfHi2kLMyXc8u27) and [CB](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tDHKLKq8ENnxfWKEA), but due to their relative lack of usefulness they will not be covered here.
text_zh: [B 型長天線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xiJHmjsXcMQyQZ1d9)最高的一道脊在左側。顯著的區域包含從[雅羅斯拉夫爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZdC9XJiP3NKKA9QA6)到[弗拉基米爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wEscjWspwirDVd696)、[圖拉州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ajNom88LdYrKfRAX6)，以及[圖瓦](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icUb6qp4Y8MzFd2P7)和[伊爾庫次克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UmZN7hTvhWZv6yKk8)附近的大部分街景。
注意：還有另外兩種長天線類型，分別稱為 [CA](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eMwfHi2kLMyXc8u27) 和 [CB](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tDHKLKq8ENnxfWKEA)，但由於它們的實用性相對較低，此處不予介紹。

text: [Blurred long antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uqSetFHbhpcz8xoy9) is visibly blurrier than other long antenna cars, and is a strong clue for [Sakhalin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NZW6zaBoyGu7Wn6u7) and [various](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zcueGiDZjMNgD5PZA) [roads](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UyHPvXwew65N9W1C8) in the east, as well as much of [Khanty-Mansi](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Vpwb7fPXkVYdxHmYA). On the other end there exists a blurred antenna in far western [Bryansk Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nKJyHgpuCi95BtWu7) and some of [Tula Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/44N5R9CyPjxWu2RL9).
text_zh: [模糊長天線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uqSetFHbhpcz8xoy9)明顯比其他長天線車更模糊，這是[薩哈林](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NZW6zaBoyGu7Wn6u7)、東部[各個](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zcueGiDZjMNgD5PZA)[道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UyHPvXwew65N9W1C8)以及大部分[漢特-曼西](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Vpwb7fPXkVYdxHmYA)地區的重要線索。另外，在極西部的[布良斯克州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nKJyHgpuCi95BtWu7)以及部分[圖拉州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/44N5R9CyPjxWu2RL9)也有模糊的天線。

text: The [tilted short antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9dsW6TyNZJ1vTVo69) is visibly tilted to the left and can be found primarily on a diagonal from [St. Petersburg](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uYJumDRfPtDcYF8i7) down to [Volgograd](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HcLrcfJw396hVA3k6), with exceptions in [Stavropol](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xnVy4Amy7TYgydFG6) and [Ufa.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3ndyQtC4AoWqDXns5) Since the ridge is on the same side, it can sometimes appear as the A-type short antenna.
text_zh: [傾斜短天線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9dsW6TyNZJ1vTVo69)明顯向左傾斜，主要出現在從[聖彼得堡](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uYJumDRfPtDcYF8i7)一路延伸至[伏爾加格勒](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HcLrcfJw396hVA3k6)的對角線上，[斯塔夫羅波爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xnVy4Amy7TYgydFG6)和[烏法](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3ndyQtC4AoWqDXns5)則有少數例外。由於脊位於同一側，它有時看起來會像是 A 型短天線。

text: A large, red brake light is common in Kaliningrad, however it can also be found in some [older coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/bms7QA2bzAr5VLBX8) in western Russia.
text_zh: 大型紅色煞車燈在加里寧格勒很常見，不過它也可以在俄羅斯西部的一些[較舊街景](https://goo.gl/maps/bms7QA2bzAr5VLBX8)中找到。

text: Autumn Generation 3 coverage is common in Kaliningrad, Bryansk, Tula, and Belgorod in western Russia, but Kaliningrad only has autumn coverage.
text_zh: 秋季相機世代 3 街景常見於俄羅斯西部的加里寧格勒、布良斯克、圖拉和別爾哥羅德，但加里寧格勒只有秋季街景。

text: In Generation 4 coverage, **significant snow on the ground** is most commonly seen in Saratov Oblast and Eastern Voronezh Oblast.
text_zh: 在相機世代 4 街景中，**地面上有明顯積雪**的情況最常出現在薩拉托夫州和沃羅涅日州東部。

text: **Generation 4** coverage is quite extensive and is found in most federal subjects in the country. Notably, areas like the Altai mountains and most of the Far East lack Generation 4 completely. Knowing where Generation 4 can be found isn’t the most helpful at the beginner level; other clues like season and car are more important. The dark red signifies areas where all of the coverage is Generation 4.
text_zh: **相機世代 4** 街景相當廣泛，國內大多數聯邦主體都能找到。值得注意的是，阿爾泰山脈和大部分遠東地區完全沒有相機世代 4。對新手來說，知道哪裡有相機世代 4 並不是最有幫助的技巧；季節和車輛等其他線索更為重要。深紅色代表所有街景均為相機世代 4 的區域。

text: [Winter Generation 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tKFTbt1t6mYGmF1CA) is most common in the south of Russia, ranging from [Ryazan](https://www.google.com/maps/@54.521468,41.2920492,3a,75y,136.68h,90.82t,1.58r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8GGSJc8bRgrChfct0st5lg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) all the way down to [Kabardino-Balkaria](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sqbQHZkc1aXttg8G9) and [Dagestan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eSpNpPM7VYWquBPN7). Winter can appear differently depending on the month (and even time of month the coverage was taken) which can be used to further regionguess.
text_zh: [冬季相機世代 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tKFTbt1t6mYGmF1CA)在俄羅斯南部最為常見，範圍從[梁贊](https://www.google.com/maps/@54.521468,41.2920492,3a,75y,136.68h,90.82t,1.58r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8GGSJc8bRgrChfct0st5lg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)一路延伸至[卡巴爾達-巴爾卡爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sqbQHZkc1aXttg8G9)和[達吉斯坦](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eSpNpPM7VYWquBPN7)。冬季景觀會根據月份（甚至拍攝當月的時间）而有所不同，這可以用來進一步推測地區。

text: [Spring Generation 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mxR9jx12qcpoqiX47) is common in several distinct places, such as around [Kemerovo](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AYpeDSAXjY4DTcfHA) and [Krasnoyarsk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6XmSQBo12yhE4peS7), [Orenburg](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gGk8Qr7GFamJkEUj9) and [Kamyshin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Xzo5rBpi1mDngfmw7), around [Lipetsk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5rDYMi3imMh6wZ9S6), and in [Moscow city](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CzcoMF9KbXZqerCWA). Differentiating these places typically comes down to landscape, as they tend to be fairly distinct.
text_zh: [春季相機世代 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mxR9jx12qcpoqiX47)常見於幾個不同的地方，例如[克麥羅沃](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AYpeDSAXjY4DTcfHA)和[克拉斯諾亞爾斯克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6XmSQBo12yhE4peS7)周邊、[奧倫堡](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gGk8Qr7GFamJkEUj9)與[卡梅申](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Xzo5rBpi1mDngfmw7)、[利佩茨克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5rDYMi3imMh6wZ9S6)周邊，以及[莫斯科市內](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CzcoMF9KbXZqerCWA)。區分這些地方通常取決於地貌，因為它們往往具有相當鮮明的特色。

text: [Summer Generation 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/87VXQczGm3HeChX18) is the most common coverage in generation 4. It is pretty much everywhere except in the south and some of the east, but can be further subdivided by car colour.
text_zh: [夏季相機世代 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/87VXQczGm3HeChX18)是相機世代 4 中最常見的覆蓋類型。除了南部和部分東部地區外，它幾乎無處不在，但可以進一步根據車輛顏色來細分。

text: [Autumn Generation 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4ePdHYjvkycsZWMP6) is quite rare and only found around [Kazan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CuYMZ5RFdFKH4CFX7) and a few roads in [Murmansk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FVbne7gzizSc2mdu8), as well as some of [Ulan-Ude](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cGxwLd6k866DgMRr9).
text_zh: [秋季相機世代 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4ePdHYjvkycsZWMP6)相當罕見，僅出現在[喀山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CuYMZ5RFdFKH4CFX7)周邊、[摩爾曼斯克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FVbne7gzizSc2mdu8)的幾條道路上，以及[烏蘭烏德](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cGxwLd6k866DgMRr9)的部分路段。

text: [Generation 4 red car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XZNnHtvtZbyWYqt99) is the most common generation 4 car meta, found primarily east around [Khanty-Mansi](https://maps.app.goo.gl/urkHYCZryyhY8kxdA), as well as along the main highways down to [Irkutsk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xm2khKQjsmjipnq9A) and [Ulan-Ude](https://maps.app.goo.gl/camcQ4mEZpFN61Um9). There is also a sizable patch near [Penza](https://maps.app.goo.gl/V1cagu4DLNtD9pGq5) and [Tatarstan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vitVoMssWGjKgixL6), as well as [Rostov-on-Don](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YCTYFcj5NZ1efTRN9).
text_zh: [相機世代 4 紅車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XZNnHtvtZbyWYqt99)是最常見的相機世代 4 車輛特徵，主要出現在東部的[漢特-曼西](https://maps.app.goo.gl/urkHYCZryyhY8kxdA)周邊，以及通往[伊爾庫次克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xm2khKQjsmjipnq9A)和[烏蘭烏德](https://maps.app.goo.gl/camcQ4mEZpFN61Um9)的主要高速公路上。[奔薩](https://maps.app.goo.gl/V1cagu4DLNtD9pGq5)與[韃靼斯坦](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vitVoMssWGjKgixL6)附近以及[頓河畔羅斯托夫](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YCTYFcj5NZ1efTRN9)也有相當規模的分佈。

text: [Generation 4 white car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ysyGKt4TvtWbGAHC7) is found in the May coverage near [Lipetsk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FS32oVQjxE4G5bu57), in [Moscow city](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YtkYaj1V3t1P5nqk9), and most notably across all the coverage north of Berkatit in the [Sakha Republic](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vE7pUiAVqX3rvTAg7) and [Magadan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AGFGntoW6UFFcPm79).
text_zh: [相機世代 4 白車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ysyGKt4TvtWbGAHC7)見於[利佩茨克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FS32oVQjxE4G5bu57)附近的 5 月街景、[莫斯科市內](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YtkYaj1V3t1P5nqk9)，以及最顯著的[薩哈共和國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vE7pUiAVqX3rvTAg7)和[馬加丹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AGFGntoW6UFFcPm79)境內貝爾卡吉特以北的所有街景。

text: [Generation 4 black car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hV1BDavTfgWjBezk8) is found mostly near [Moscow](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d3GSjMCXAaZiwfBp9), [Tver](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UqwBFR7gry7wDpZy9), and [Voronezh](https://maps.app.goo.gl/p5YktDMBB7Mksd8SA), with some also existing in [Tatarstan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/w6tJLmTsuvTsMHvJ6) and less commonly in the south.
text_zh: [相機世代 4 黑車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hV1BDavTfgWjBezk8)主要出現在[莫斯科](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d3GSjMCXAaZiwfBp9)、[特維爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UqwBFR7gry7wDpZy9)和[沃羅涅日](https://maps.app.goo.gl/p5YktDMBB7Mksd8SA)附近，[韃靼斯坦](https://maps.app.goo.gl/w6tJLmTsuvTsMHvJ6)也有部分分佈，南部則較少見。

text: All the coverage in Rwanda is made with a Generation 4 camera. In most of the coverage, the Google car is a pickup truck which will be covered entirely by a **big blur**.
text_zh: 盧安達所有的街景覆蓋都是用第四代相機拍攝的。在大多數的覆蓋中，Google 車是一輛皮卡車，其車身會完全被一個**大模糊塊**遮蓋住。

text: Sometimes the Google car is entirely visible: it is a big **white **or **brown pickup truck** with a brakelight. The camera mount is visible.
text_zh: 有時可以看到整台 Google 車：是一輛帶有煞車燈的大型**白色**或**棕色皮卡車**。相機支架清晰可見。

text: The coverage has a noticeable **hazy tint** to it, which is especially apparent in the sky.
NOTE: In Africa, similar hazy Generation 4 coverage is common in Senegal.
text_zh: 街景覆蓋帶有明顯的**朦朧色調**，在天空中尤其明顯。
注意：在非洲，類似的模糊第四代街景在塞內加爾也很常見。

text: Rwanda has **quite limited coverage**: street view is limited to Kigali, and a couple of other patches elsewhere in Rwanda.
NOTE: Coverage is being sporadically released, so click the link below to view an up-to-date map.
_You can check out the coverage in detail on [this site](https://sv-map.netlify.app#base=roadmap&cov=official&zoom=10&center=-1.9256780081968785%2C30.20828247070313)._
text_zh: 盧安達的**街景覆蓋相當有限**：街景僅限於基加利（Kigali），以及盧安達其他地區的少數幾個範圍。
注意：覆蓋範圍正陸續零星釋出，因此請點擊下方連結以檢視最新地圖。
_你可以在[這個網站](https://sv-map.netlify.app#base=roadmap&cov=official&zoom=10&center=-1.9256780081968785%2C30.20828247070313)上查看詳細的街景覆蓋。_

text: Serbia has **4 different truck colours** that were used in different areas.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞有 **4 種不同的卡車顏色**，被用在不同的區域。

text: Serbia also has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot. And a short antenna or black blur can be seen on the backside.
NOTE: Most of the Balkans also have Smallcam.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞也有第 4 代「小型相機（smallcam）」街景覆蓋，其安裝位置比一般的第 4 代低，且有一個相對大的圓形模糊，前方有一個小突起。這個模糊也可能是完全透明的，讓人比較難以察覺。背面還可以看到一根短天線或黑色模糊。
注意：巴爾幹半島的大部分地區也有小型相機街景。

text: Most of the generation 3 coverage in Serbia was taken by a Google car with **no antenna**.
NOTE: Other than North Macedonia, almost all of central and eastern Europe has antenna coverage in Generation 3.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞大部分的第 3 代街景覆蓋是由一台**沒有天線**的 Google 車所拍攝的。
注意：除了北馬其頓之外，幾乎整個中歐和東歐的第 3 代街景都有天線。

text: This is a generation 3 coverage map of Serbia. Most of the coverage is in the north in Vojvodina, around Belgrade and in the southeast around Niš. Kosovo does not have any coverage.
text_zh: 這是塞爾維亞的第 3 代街景覆蓋地圖。大部分的覆蓋都在北部的伏伊伏丁那（Vojvodina）、貝爾格勒周邊以及東南部的尼什（Niš）周邊。科索沃沒有任何街景覆蓋。

text: Serbia uses 2 digit area codes, with the first digit **between 1 and 3**. Area codes starting with 2 are found in the north, area codes starting with 1 are found in central and eastern Serbia. Area codes starting with 3 are found in the south-west.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞使用 2 位數的區碼，首位數字**介於 1 和 3 之間**。以 2 開頭的區碼見於北部，以 1 開頭的區碼見於中部和東部塞爾維亞。以 3 開頭的區碼則見於西南部。

text: Generation 3 **Fall coverage** can be seen in this region south of Čačak, and a small area around Valjevo.
text_zh: 在恰查克（Čačak）南方這個區域以及瓦列沃（Valjevo）周邊的小區域，可以看到第 3 代的**秋季街景覆蓋**。

text: A white Google Car with a **short antenna** can be seen in Novi Sad, Kovilj, in and around Belgrade, Niš, and the E75 connecting them.
NOTE: The white car is not always visible.
text_zh: 在諾維薩德、科維利（Kovilj）、貝爾格勒市區及周邊、尼什，以及連接它們的 E75 高速公路上，可以看到一台帶有**短天線**的白色 Google 車。
註：白色轎車不一定隨時看得到。

text: A **grey pickup truck** can be found in some Generation 4 coverage.

NOTE: Similar pickup trucks can also be found in a few other countries. Most relevantly in [Georgia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/x7eAbxAkPQHsJFEZ8) but it is also found in [Senegal](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qVLNzZSjP3uTWXcg8), [Rwanda](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XAwvwbthLQEbbY1n8), [Kenya](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ggiEBc94DWL7BQwp7), [Ghana ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LN64SQFrKaRJLLoaA)and [Paraguay](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Yyuyeus81T3fYH9k8).
text_zh: 在某些 Generation 4 街景覆蓋中可以發現一台**灰色皮卡車**。

注意：類似的皮卡車也出現在其他少數國家。最相關的是在[喬治亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/x7eAbxAkPQHsJFEZ8)，但它也出現在[塞內加爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qVLNzZSjP3uTWXcg8)、[盧安達](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XAwvwbthLQEbbY1n8)、[肯亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ggiEBc94DWL7BQwp7)、[迦納](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LN64SQFrKaRJLLoaA)和[巴拉圭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Yyuyeus81T3fYH9k8)。

text: **Generation 2** coverage is **rare** in the US. If you have a Generation 2 location in a North American setting, you are more likely to be in Canada.
The exception to this is Alaska, and to a lesser extent Hawaii, which have a fair amount of Generation 2. You can also rarely see Generation 2 in rural areas of the Deep South.
**Generation 3** coverage is also significantly less common than in Canada.
text_zh: **第 2 代**街景覆蓋在美國**非常少見**。如果你在北美地區看到第 2 代的街景，你更有可能是身處加拿大。
唯一的例外阿拉斯加，以及夏威夷（程度較輕），這兩地有相當多的第二代相機世代。在深南部（Deep South）的鄉村地區也很少見地能看到第二代相機世代。
**第 3 代**街景覆蓋也比加拿大少得多。

text: In addition to having less Generation 3 coverage than Canada, the side mirrors are also blurred out differently: While they generally appear as two peaks in Canadian Gen 3 coverage, you will mostly see a **single peak** in the US.
text_zh: 除了第 3 代覆蓋比加拿大少之外，後視鏡的模糊處理方式也不同：加拿大第 3 代覆蓋中的後視鏡通常呈現兩個尖峰的形狀，而在美國你主要會看到**單一尖峰**。

text: **Generation 3** coverage in the US and Canada generally has **no visible antenna**. This can be helpful to distinguish it from Europe in low-info rounds. Some European Generation 3 coverage has no visible antenna, but most of it does.

There is an important exception: in national parks in the US, you can find a Generation 3 car with a [stubby antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/6nngRLvsmvVm7SPS8) with diagonal coils around it. Still, this specific type of antenna is not found in Europe.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大的**第 3 代**街景覆蓋通常**沒有明顯的天線**。在資訊較少的局數中，這有助於將其與歐洲區分開來。部分歐洲的第 3 代覆蓋沒有明顯的天線，但大多數都有。
有一個重要的例外：在美國的國家公園裡，你可以找到一台第 3 相機世代的車輛，其配備了帶有對角線線圈的[粗短天線](https://goo.gl/maps/6nngRLvsmvVm7SPS8)。不過，這種特定類型的天線在歐洲是找不到的。

text: Both the US and Canada also have Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot. When the car isn’t blurred properly, you will usually see a mirror sticking out on the right side.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大也都有第 4 世代「smallcam」街景覆蓋，其架設高度比一般的第 4 世代低，並且下方有一個相對較大的圓形模糊，前端帶有小凸起。該模糊也可能完全透明，使其更難察覺。當車子沒有被完美模糊時，你通常會看到右側凸出一個後視鏡。

text: **Interstate Highways** are divided highways that often span large areas of the United States. Even-numbered Interstates run west to east, with the lowest numbers along the Gulf Coast and Mexico border. Odd-numbered highways run south to north, with the lowest numbers along the West Coast.

**US Highways** are also typically long roads that are sometimes (but not always) divided. The numbering system is generally the inverse of Interstate Highways, with low odd-numbered highways located along the East Coast and low even-numbered highways located close to the Canadian border in the north of the country.
NOTE: There are generally more exceptions to the US Highway numbering system than the Interstate Highway numbering system, in terms of placement.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **州際公路**是橫跨美國大片區域的雙向分隔公路。偶數編號的州際公路東西走向，最低的編號位於墨西哥灣沿岸和墨西哥邊界。奇數編號的公路南北走向，最低的編號則位於西海岸。
**美國國道**通常也是長途道路，有時（但非總是）為分隔公路。編號系統大致與州際公路相反，奇數編號較低的公路位於東海岸，而偶數編號較低的公路則位於該國北部的加拿大邊境附近。
注意：就位置而言，美國國道編號系統的例外情況通常比州際公路編號系統更多。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: US telephone numbers start with a three-digit **area code**. While these area codes are not clustered by initial digits, they are useful to learn.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 美國電話號碼以三位數的**區域號碼**開頭。雖然這些區域號碼並非按初始數字群聚，但很值得學習它們。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Each state has their own highway shield. Some states have their own **unique, recognizable** highway shields that can be seen here.
text_zh: 每個州都有自己的公路盾牌標誌。有些州擁有獨特且**易於辨識**的公路盾牌，可以在這裡看到。

text: Most states have unique, distinct and learnable [Adopt-a-Highway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adopt-a-Highway) signs, which can be seen on the side of roads. A map of those can be seen here. Keep in mind, some states have slight variations in design.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 大多數州都有獨特、鮮明且易於學習的[認養公路](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adopt-a-Highway)標誌，這些標誌可以在道路旁看到。可以在這裡查看這些標誌的地圖。請記住，有些州的設計有些許差異。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Blue and yellow** shields are used for county roads, and can be seen in certain states in the US. Keep in mind, unique designs can be found in some counties in certain states. For more information, see [here](https://geohints.com/countries/us/signs/countyRoads).
text_zh: **藍色和黃色**的盾牌用於郡道，可以在美國的特定州看到。請記住，某些州的特定郡中可以找到獨特的設計。欲了解更多資訊，請參閱[此處](https://geohints.com/countries/us/signs/countyRoads)。

text: As part of a promotional campaign, the TransAmerica Trail from Oregon to North Carolina was covered by a **Ford Bronco**. The car can be recognised by its unblurred black roof and red hood, and is mostly found on unpaved rural roads.
Looking [backwards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zb8pFNSX2FFoRmK98), you will see two other Ford SUVs escorting the camera car.
text_zh: 作為宣傳活動的一部分，從奧勒岡州到北卡羅萊納州的跨美洲步道（TransAmerica Trail）是由一輛**福特野馬（Ford Bronco）**所拍攝的。這輛車可以透過其未模糊的黑色車頂和紅色引擎蓋來識別，主要出現在未鋪裝的鄉村道路上。
往[後方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zb8pFNSX2FFoRmK98)看，你會看到另外兩輛護送相機車的 Ford 休旅車。

intro.lead: 街景本身的特徵：畫質、季節、拍攝密度
body: 覆蓋特徵指的不是畫面內容，而是這段街景本身的性質：解析度高低、拍攝年份、季節、以及某些國家特有的低機位或整段只有主要幹道有覆蓋。
看到明顯偏舊或偏糊的畫面時，這一類可以幫你判斷是哪一批拍攝，進而縮小地區。
